description: Returns all traces of a given transaction.

parameters.name: transactionHash
parameters.description: The transaction hash that needs to be traced, encoded in hexadecimal format

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The tracer object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: tracer
sub_parameters.description: The type of tracer. It could be callTracer or prestateTracer

sub_parameters.name: callTracer
sub_parameters.description: The calltracer keeps track of all call frames, including depth 0 calls, that are made during a transaction

sub_parameters.name: prestateTracer
sub_parameters.description: The prestateTracer replays the transaction and tracks every part of state that occured during the transaction

sub_parameters.name: tracerConfig
sub_parameters.description: The object to specify the configurations of the tracer

sub_parameters.name: onlyTopCall
sub_parameters.description: When set to true, this will only trace the primary (top-level) call and not any sub-calls. It eliminates the additional processing for each call frame

sub_parameters.name: diffMode
sub_parameters.description: When set to true, diff mode returns the differences between the transaction's pre and post-state. The result object will contain a pre and a post object.

sub_parameters.name: timeout
sub_parameters.description: A string of decimal integers that overrides the JavaScript-based tracing calls default timeout of 5 seconds

from.description: The address the transaction is sent from

to.description: The address the transaction is directed to

value.description: The integer of the value sent with this transaction

gas.description: The integer of the gas provided for the transaction execution

gasUsed.description: The integer of the gas used

input.description: The data given at the time of input

output.description: The data which is returned as an output

error.description: The type of error, if any

revertReason.description: The type solidity revert reason, if any
